data.body: VERIFICATION NOTE: timings via .claude/scripts/dso ticket show id in this session continue to show 67s for 8-hex even with the fix applied. Cause: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is set to the main repo plugin path, not the worktree. The dso shim resolution prefers CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT over the relative dso.plugin_root config, so dso commands in worktree sessions execute main-repo plugin code. End-to-end verification (with CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT pointed at worktree plugin) confirms the fix works. Once this PR merges to main, the shim will pick up the fix transparently. Follow-up filed for the shim routing issue.
